title: Fixed Radial Spring Round Trampoline
description: One newly authored whole static round trampoline exterior. A complete thin closed bed has a shallow authored sag and a continuous perimeter; twenty-four separate whole radial three-turn coil tubes with continuous tails connect its rim to one complete tubular outer frame. A narrow raised rim pad follows the outer ring without hiding the entire spring gap. Three complete curved U legs meet the frame at six points and rest on six finite broad ground pads. The whole new suspension/perimeter/underframe topology is not the old central-pedestal roundabout without rails, a circular recolour of a floor mat, or repeated vertical spring riders. All geometry newly authored and editable, three constant opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One whole model, zero scenes. Fixed illustrative unoccupied exterior only: no elastic bed or coil simulation, actual spring tension, jumping, rebound, body fit, user suitability, guard or enclosure system, entrapment protection, load, stability, manufacture or sports/playground safety claim.
